cohort: 271 singleton pregnant women who had 37-42 weeks of gestation, were diagnosed with thick meconium-stained amniotic fluid and a normal FHR pattern
finding: Modes of delivery were not associated with adverse neonatal outcomes, but oxytocin use > 3 h was associated with adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Modes of delivery were not associated with adverse neonatal outcomes.
